slides.headline: The Tech News You Need Today
slides.subtitle: From eclipse views to new Google gadgets, here is what’s happening in tech.

slides.headline: A rare view of the solar eclipse
slides.explanation: Millions across Europe watched a solar eclipse as the path of totality crossed Greenland, Iceland, and Spain. It was a rare chance to see a spectacular sunset event.

slides.headline: Why AI rings are the new wearables
slides.explanation: Sandbar and other companies are betting that voice-based AI rings are the next big thing in hardware. These devices aim to simplify how we capture meeting notes and daily tasks.

slides.headline: Meta smart glasses face legal challenge
slides.explanation: A German nonprofit has filed a criminal complaint regarding privacy concerns around Meta's smart glasses. It highlights the growing scrutiny over how wearable tech collects data.

slides.headline: Google unveils its 2026 hardware lineup
slides.explanation: Google just announced the Pixel 11, a new Pixel Watch, and a competitor to the Apple AirTag. These updates show the company is leaning heavily into new Gemini AI features.

slides.headline: Honor’s new phone has a wiggling camera
slides.explanation: Honor launched a new phone featuring an automated pop-up camera gimbal. The camera can actually move and wiggle to help you get the perfect shot.

title: Five Stories You Need to Know

slides.headline: Five Stories You Need to Know
slides.subtitle: From White House changes to high-stakes legal battles, here is your daily update.

slides.headline: A Swift-Kelce Wedding Update
slides.explanation: Travis Kelce confirmed he and Taylor Swift are married and shared details about their Madison Square Garden ceremony. It is a rare personal update from the couple that has fans talking.

slides.headline: Transparency Concerns at DHS
slides.explanation: Immigration officials did not publicly disclose the death of a Guatemalan man who suffered a seizure while in custody. This incident highlights ongoing questions about how government agencies report deaths within detention centers.

slides.headline: White House Staff Departure
slides.explanation: Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt is leaving her position to spend more time with her family. High-level staff changes in the White House often signal shifts in administration focus and communication strategy.

slides.headline: A Decoy Flight for Security
slides.explanation: Officials say Marco Rubio and Scott Bessent stayed on a decoy flight while President Trump switched planes in Turkey. This maneuver shows the intense security measures taken to protect top government officials during international travel.

slides.headline: Texas Judge Orders Life-Saving Care
slides.explanation: A judge in Texas ordered medical care for a newborn after a dispute regarding treatment for a congenital heart condition. The case illustrates the complex intersection of state law and emergency medical decision-making.
